doc.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007

title: Distribution, radio play and digital downloading
summary: Allegro distributes Arbors; digital downloads are becoming a significant income stream.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: And do most of your sales come through mail order?

Well it’s an interesting question. We do have Allegro Music in Portland, Oregon as our principal distributor in the U.S. and Canada, and we have distributors in various countries © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

overseas. But we don’t really sell a lot of our product. Somehow or other our product is more influential than the sales volume that we have of a particular CD. We get a lot of radio play, we get a lot of good reviews in jazz publications. We do have a website so that we do get a lot of mail order business. And now what’s starting to take hold is digital downloading. We have a lot of our catalogue on these digital downloading sites, you know ninety-nine cents a track, you know, that sort of thing.
Okay well that was really my question regarding technology, that you are taking advantage of that.

Yes. Well we’re linked to it in the sense that we’ve only really started in the last year or so to take advantage of it. On our website we always had snippets of our records, you know 45 seconds of this or that, but we’ve never really gone into digital downloading and digital direct marketing. But we are going to be doing a lot more of that because I think that’s the wave of the future.
Does it seem to, have you been able to tell so far, if it’s working as far as your getting compensation.
Yeah we have a company that handles that. We got it through our distributor, Allegro. They have a company that they’re working with in turn.
I don’t know what that is.
I don’t know but they’re driving me crazy. It could be two floors down in a wall.

Anyway we have a company that we’ve been working with through our distributor, Allegro Music, and that’s starting to become a fairly significant income stream for us. And it’s something that I think is increasing. And one of the things that we want to try to do is to make that fact more available.
We’ll just call it sound effects.

Right. But make it more available because the whole secret of web marketing is that people know you’re there and people will come to look for you, and how — this is something I was talking with the product manager for jazz of Allegro is here at this convention and we were just talking about that, how to make our downloading more visible.
No. They had one last year but they don’t have one this year.
